curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: recognise the target sounds /dʒ/, /s/ and /ŋ/ used in words for effective communication

mission.title: recognise the target sounds /dʒ/, /s/ and /ŋ/ used in words for effective communication

interactions.prompt: Which word begins with the /dʒ/ sound heard in ‘jam’?
interactions.retryHint: Listen for the sound at the start of jam.
Listen for the soft hissing sound.

interactions.prompt: Sort each word by its target sound.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then tap the sound you hear.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word slowly; /ŋ/ is often heard at the end of ring and sing.

interactions.prompt: Read: ‘We sing a song.’ Which word ends with /ŋ/?
interactions.retryHint: Listen to the final sound in each word.

interactions.prompt: Match each word to the target sound in it.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then tap its target sound.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You recognised all three target sounds.
interactions.retryHint: Use jump for /dʒ/, sun for /s/, and long for /ŋ/.

interactions.prompt: Which set has /dʒ/, /s/ and /ŋ/ in that order?
interactions.feedback: Mission complete! Juice has /dʒ/, six has /s/, and ring has /ŋ/.
interactions.retryHint: Check the words one sound at a time.
